verdict.rationale: Unleash supports activation strategies and constraints (segments, custom activation strategies and targeting) that can target or exclude specific users/groups, and tokens/environments allow scoping test rollouts to internal accounts, but no evidence pack item explicitly documents a simple 'individual user allowlist/exclude by userId' UI feature or shows a hands-on example of listing specific beta tester IDs. missing for 10: explicit documentation/example of per-user allowlist or exclude-by-userId targeting UI, independent/hands-on confirmation of this exact workflow beyond generic 'custom activation strategies and targeting' marketing copy.
